_comment: Public employer job-board feeds, discovered 2026-08-17 by probing every company in config/companies.json against Ashby, Greenhouse and Lever. 40 of 108 resolved. Slug and platform are verified live; jobs is the count at discovery time. WIRED as a source since 2026-08-17 via sources._fetch_ats(); this file is its board list. Contributed 2,773 of 3,190 postings on the 2026-08-17 run.
_why: Small companies mostly do not post to job boards — a sub-100-person team was measured at 3/10 findability that way. These feeds come straight from the employer, so there is no aggregator rail, no injected salary estimate, and no feed category masquerading as a location.

_yc_channel: YC directory (yc-oss.github.io/api/companies/all.json, no auth) filtered to status=Active AND isHiring AND team_size 11-100 AND AI-tagged AND batch>=2021, then probed for an ATS board. This is the hidden-gem channel: companies this small mostly do not post to job boards at all, which is the 3/10 findability measured earlier.
_why_remote_first_scale: Added by hand 2026-08-18. The 119 discovered boards were overwhelmingly YC companies under 100 people, and measurement showed only 2% of their in-lane roles could be worked from abroad - small companies mostly hire in one city. The freedom the operator is optimising for lives at companies that already run global payroll. These sixteen are the remote-first ones worth reading daily. Marked pinned so a discovery run cannot drop them; team_size is approximate and only feeds a 4-point tiebreaker.
_expansion_note: 2026-08-18: 23 boards added after probing 75 candidates live. Chosen for global-employment (Oyster), remote-first culture (Zapier), LATAM presence (Bitso, Belvo), creator economy (Kit, Ghost), and support tooling where a service background is the qualification (Intercom, Plain, Pylon). Marked pinned so discover.py cannot drop them. | 2026-09-30: probed 45 luxury, membership and hospitality employers after the operator asked about member-manager roles. Only 6 expose a Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby feed and are added here. American Express, Marriott, Hyatt, Accor, Inspirato, Quintessentially, Virtuoso, Internova, Mr & Mrs Smith, Soho House, NetJets and 28 others answer on none of the three platforms ats.py speaks — they run Workday, iCIMS or custom. companies.json has paid +3 for hospitality_tech since August for employers the pipeline could never fetch. Reaching that lane needs a Workday adapter, not more slugs.
